text: {"features":[{"name":"Role alignment","description":"How specifically the letter connects the applicant's background and goals to Google's Information Security Engineering mission for this role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows broad interest in software or security but does not connect the applicant's background to the specific mission of this role."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Google, security, or backend work in general terms, yet the link to this team's responsibilities remains thin."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects interest to secure development, automation, or backend security work at a general level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly ties past work and career goals to this team's mission of reducing manual security effort, helping developers, or protecting the development lifecycle."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates precise understanding of the role's mandate, such as scaling scarce security judgment, automating vulnerability triage or variant analysis, or building security tooling with Google-wide leverage."}]},{"name":"Security mindset","description":"How thoughtfully the letter articulates a security-engineering philosophy centered on rigor, resilience, and attacker-aware design.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in security without revealing a distinct security-engineering perspective."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States broad security values, but the philosophy is generic and lightly developed."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Articulates at least one concrete security principle, such as secure defaults, attacker-minded review, or quiet resilience."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows a mature security philosophy grounded in rigor, engineering discipline, resilience, and thoughtful tradeoffs."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents an especially memorable and well-integrated security philosophy that shapes both the letter's framing and the candidate's examples."}]},{"name":"Academic preparation","description":"The strength of formal academic preparation the letter presents for a software-security engineering role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Presents a relevant bachelor's degree or equivalent baseline preparation, with no graduate degree."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Presents bachelor's-level preparation plus some added formal depth, but still no completed relevant graduate degree."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a relevant master's degree."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents advanced graduate specialization beyond a standard master's-level statement."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a relevant doctoral degree."}]},{"name":"Professional experience depth","description":"The extent of relevant software-engineering experience shown through years in role and repeated ownership of production systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only baseline qualifying experience, with limited scope or only a small number of production systems mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Clearly meets the minimum and mentions testing, maintenance, or launches, but the scope of ownership remains modest."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid mid-level experience through several years in role and multiple production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong production experience through repeated launches and ongoing ownership of several systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Conveys extensive, battle-tested experience across many production services and the full test-maintain-launch lifecycle."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"How strongly the letter establishes Go as a core production language for the applicant.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only briefly or as one language among many, with no signal of primary ownership."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some regular use of Go in production, but not that it is central to the candidate's work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a main working language for backend services or infrastructure."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Frames Go as the primary or daily language and ties it to significant production responsibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows deep Go-centered ownership by using Go as the backbone of relevant backend or security tooling systems."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How strongly the letter establishes Python as a meaningful production language for the applicant.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no meaningful evidence of Python use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python casually, mostly as light scripting or a secondary tool."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for tooling, automation, analysis, or services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows extensive production Python work across services and internal tooling, often with quality signals such as typing or testing."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes Python a major strength by showing deep ownership of production Python systems or Python-based agents highly relevant to the role."}]},{"name":"AI experience","description":"How convincingly the letter shows applied experience building and shipping AI-enabled systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions no AI experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows interest in AI or mentions it vaguely without a shipped use case."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Cites practical AI or LLM work in production but gives little detail about reliability, evaluation, or controls."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes shipped AI features together with controls such as testing, evaluation, or hardening for unpredictable behavior."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial applied AI experience with clear operational discipline and direct relevance to trustworthy automation or agent-based systems."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates experience designing or operating agent-based systems relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of agent-based system design."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Refers to automation or AI broadly, but not to agents or their architecture."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions building agentic pipelines or agents, but with limited architectural detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly describes agent-based systems, usually pairing Python agents with Go services, guardrails, or auditable actions."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong agentic-systems design depth through detailed discussion of agent autonomy, contracts, supervision, permissions, logging, or bounded execution."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability triage automation","description":"How concretely the letter shows experience automating the intake, triage, routing, or deduplication of security findings.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions no vulnerability-handling automation experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Speaks generally about reducing manual security work but gives no example of actual triage automation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions some automation around vulnerability reports or queues, but with limited detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly states ownership of a vulnerability triage workflow such as intake, routing, prioritization, or deduplication."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Describes an end-to-end vulnerability-handling system with multiple steps automated and a clear reduction in manual effort or better response quality."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"How much hands-on experience the letter shows in evaluating systems for security weaknesses and validating fixes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions no security-assessment work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals security interest or attacker awareness, but no concrete assessment activity."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions threat modeling, reviews, or assessments without much method detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes structured assessment work such as threat models, code review, attack-surface analysis, or review of services the candidate did not write."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong, repeated assessment practice with clear methods, remediation follow-through, or insight into how assessments should be automated."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic depth","description":"How convincingly the letter shows practical strength with data structures and algorithms.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of algorithmic skill."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Makes a generic claim about algorithms or performance without a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives one specific example of choosing a better data structure or algorithm to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong practical algorithmic thinking applied to important system bottlenecks or core logic."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents especially strong algorithmic fluency by transforming difficult workloads or bottlenecks through well-chosen algorithms or data structures."}]},{"name":"Evidence-backed detail","description":"How well the letter supports its claims with concrete systems, actions, and outcomes rather than generic assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad claims of competence, with little concrete technical evidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes some specifics such as years, tools, or broad responsibilities, but few implementation details or outcomes."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports at least one important claim with a concrete example of what was built or improved."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Consistently backs major claims with specific technical examples, responsibilities, or results."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Grounds nearly every major claim in concrete systems, actions, and outcomes, making the fit unusually easy to verify."}]},{"name":"Open-source stewardship","description":"The extent to which the letter shows sustained contribution to or maintenance of open-source software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no open-source evidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Touches open source only lightly, without clear contribution or maintenance responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes occasional bug fixes or patches sent upstream."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows regular contribution or maintenance responsibility for a project."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial stewardship, such as maintaining an actively used project, reviewing outside contributions, and shipping releases."}]},{"name":"Adversarial practice","description":"How strongly the letter shows ongoing hands-on practice in offensive or attacker-oriented security work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows no independent adversarial security practice."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional security exercises or a general attacker perspective without sustained practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Indicates regular participation in capture-the-flag or similar hands-on exercises."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows serious adversarial practice through strong competition results or clearly sustained commitment."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates exceptional attacker-oriented practice, with repeated top results or equivalent evidence that the work materially sharpens security judgment."}]},{"name":"Security credentials","description":"The strength of externally recognized security credentials used to substantiate the applicant's security background.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions no security credential or external validation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Alludes to formal security learning, but names no recognized credential."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Lists an entry-level credential that supports fundamentals, such as Security+."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Lists a stronger hands-on credential or multiple credentials, but without strongly tying them to demonstrated capability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Uses a demanding hands-on credential such as OSCP as direct evidence of practical exploitation or assessment ability."}]},{"name":"Personal project complexity","description":"How much the letter's side projects demonstrate initiative and technically ambitious engineering.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions no personal project."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions only a small utility or simple full-stack project with limited technical depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a complete side project that demonstrates initiative and end-to-end ownership but modest complexity."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a technically ambitious backend or distributed-systems project with meaningful engineering difficulty."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a highly ambitious personal system that tackles hard reliability, consistency, or failure-mode problems in depth."}]},{"name":"Narrative coherence","description":"How effectively the letter forms a clear, connected argument for fit rather than a loose list of qualifications.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as disjointed or list-like, with little connective tissue between motivation, experience, and fit."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a basic structure, but transitions are weak and the case for fit feels stitched together from separate points."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a clear overall case with recognizable introduction, evidence, and closing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Maintains a strong throughline that smoothly connects experience, motivation, and role fit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers an especially cohesive and persuasive narrative in which each paragraph advances the same well-integrated case for this role."}]},{"name":"Mechanical polish","description":"How free the letter is from spelling, grammar, and typographical errors that distract from professionalism.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent spelling, typographical, or grammatical errors repeatedly distract and weaken professionalism."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Multiple noticeable errors appear throughout, but the overall meaning remains clear."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"A few minor mechanical issues appear, yet the letter still reads as professional."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Prose is clean and controlled, with only rare slips."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Prose is essentially error-free and polished throughout."}]}]}
